test.title: A place where you can concentrate well

document.cue: Describe a place where you can concentrate well.

text: The place where I concentrate best is the reading room on the top floor of the National Library in Almaty. It's a big, bright hall with long wooden tables, tall windows and rows of old bookshelves along the walls.

I go there about three times a week, usually straight after my morning lectures, and I tend to stay until it closes in the evening. During exam season I practically live there — I even know most of the librarians by name.

Mostly I use it for the kind of work that needs deep focus, like writing essays or doing practice tests for IELTS. I bring my laptop, a bottle of water and nothing else, and I leave my phone in my bag on silent. Last month I wrote almost my entire course project there in just four days.

I think it works because the atmosphere does half the job for me. When everyone around you is quietly working, you feel a bit embarrassed to scroll through social media, so you just get on with it. At home, by contrast, there's always something distracting me, whether it's the TV or my younger sister.
So whenever I have something important to finish, that reading room is the first place I head for, with my laptop under my arm.

tips.en: I practically live there is a natural, conversational exaggeration.
tips.kk: I practically live there — ауызекі әсірелеу табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: I practically live there — разговорное преувеличение звучит естественно.

tips.en: The atmosphere does half the job for me shows exactly how the place helps.
tips.kk: The atmosphere does half the job for me — орынның нақты қалай көмектесетінін көрсетесіз.
tips.ru: The atmosphere does half the job for me — показываете, как именно место помогает.
tips.example: the atmosphere does half the job for me

note.en: Where it is — the exact place and what the hall looks like.
note.kk: Қайда — нақты орын және залдың сыртқы көрінісі.
note.ru: Где — точное место и как выглядит зал.

note.en: How often — with an exaggeration about exam season and a detail about the librarians.
note.kk: Қаншалықты жиі — сессия туралы әсірелеумен және кітапханашылар туралы дерекпен.
note.ru: Как часто — с преувеличением про сессию и деталью про библиотекарей.

note.en: What the speaker does — the example of a course project finished in four days.
note.kk: Не істейді — төрт күнде аяқталған курстық жоба мысалы.
note.ru: Что делает — пример с курсовым проектом за четыре дня.

note.en: Why it helps — the atmosphere and a contrast with home.
note.kk: Неге көмектеседі — атмосфера және үймен салыстыру.
note.ru: Почему помогает — атмосфера и контраст с домом.

note.en: The ending — the first place the speaker goes to.
note.ru: Итог — место, куда идёт первым делом.
